blind.B1: Not an in vivo exercise study: C2C12 myotubes, in-vitro electrical pulse stimulation (EPS, 3 h, 13 V 66 Hz) as exercise mimic, crossed with Tug1 LNA knockdown (S2.5.p2, S5.5.p3). The exercise factor is carried by the EPS 0h and EPS 3h libraries versus Rest; all 36 libraries are sequenced. Analyzable as an in-vitro exercise-mimetic series (policy item).
blind.B2: Control-LNA EPS 0h vs Rest (835 up, log2FC>1, FDR<0.01) and EPS 3h vs Rest (1316 up) (S2.5.p2); Tug1 KD vs control at Rest (351 down / 516 up, FDR<0.01; 867 total) (S2.5.p1); KD-modified EPS responses (53/101 blunted, 338/254 augmented, FDR<0.05) (S2.5.p3). n = 6 libraries per cell (triplicate wells x two independent experiments), 36 total (S5.8.p1, FIG7 legend).
blind.B3: No repeated animals or people: each library is one separate culture well. Two independent experiments (rep 1-3, rep 4-6 by title) are a possible batch factor; the title rep suffix can label it, but GEO does not document it. Same-rep keys across conditions are not same wells.
blind.B4: S5.8.p2: 'genes with >=1 RPM in at least 12 out of the 36 libraries using Voom/Limma in Degust v 4.1.5' - this implies one model on all 36 libraries; the paper does not state explicitly whether contrasts were fitted jointly.
blind.B5: S5.8.p2: 'Transcripts with a false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.05 were considered differentially expressed.' EPS-vs-Rest counts in S2.5.p2: log2FC>1, FDR<0.01, upregulated genes only (835 at EPS 0h, 1316 at EPS 3h); FIG7 legend volcano FDR<0.001. Three rules in the paper.

checks.evidence: Run as in-vitro EPS vs Rest in control myotubes, labelled in-vitro (reconstruction S2.5.p2); KD-at-rest labelled out of scope.
grp levels 6 x 6 = 36, matches S5.8.p1; no exclusions; EPS arms compared with the Rest arm of the same LNA.
Contrasts NCeps0 vs NCrest, NCeps3 vs NCrest (treatment EPS, control Rest); paper's genes (Hspa1a, Atf3, Nr4a3) are up in our result.

Independent wells (S5.8.p1); the packet key (eps + rep suffix) links NC and KD wells, not repeated samples of one unit. Experiment batch handled as a sensitivity covariate (deseq2_joint_exp, counts change <1%).
Paper filtered on 36 libraries, implying one voom model; primary fit is two-arm voom on 12 samples, joint DESeq2 on 36 as sensitivity; deviation declared in method record and HANDBACK.
exp crossed with all six cells (3+3 each); recorded in covariance.confounding; exp label flagged as inferred.
Integer counts, 55,416 genes; voom without TMM declared; p-value histogram sane (frac p>0.9 = 0.03).
FDR<0.01, log2FC>1 strict, up-only, transcribed from S2.5.p2; FIG7 legend FDR<0.001 and S5.8.p2 FDR<0.05 recorded as discrepancy; FDR<0.05 as audit.

Runner's printed comparison used total n_deg (1169/2154) against paper up-only counts; HANDBACK corrects this and compares the up columns (778/1130 voom, 908/1377 DESeq2 vs 835/1316) and flags the tool problem.

human_items: Policy: whether an in-vitro EPS series in C2C12 counts as an exercise study.
Policy: joint (Degust-style 36-library) versus two-arm voom as the primary fit when the paper implies one model; the executor cannot express a joint voom.
summary: 该案例按论文口径运行：对照LNA肌管 EPS 0h/3h 相对 Rest，样本分组 6x6 正确，方向、阈值（FDR<0.01、log2FC>1、仅上调）与论文一致，三种阈值差异已记录。没有重复测量单位，独立实验批次作为敏感性分析处理。主要偏差（双臂 voom、无 TMM）已声明，上调基因数（778/1130）接近论文（835/1316）；整体通过，仅留两项政策性问题交由人工。
